caption: Original instrumental energetic club house, 128 BPM. Punchy four-on-the-floor kick and tight bass from the first beat. Maintain a strong continuous dancefloor groove through most of the track. Rolling bass groove, crisp clap, shuffled high hats and a sparse memorable percussive synth hook. Layer percussion into the hook, one brief stripped-back phrase, immediate full-drum return and a DJ-friendly percussion outro. No vocals.
